title: Unique Alliance Partners
instructions:
Complete the `uniquePartners` function. It takes a `List<Int>` of team numbers that may contain duplicates. Convert the list to a set to remove duplicates, then return the set.

For example, `uniquePartners(listOf(4215, 1234, 4215, 5678))` should return a set containing `4215, 1234, 5678`.
hint: Use `.toSet()` on the list to convert it to a set with no duplicates.
